notes.title: Major Update is Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers, I am happy to announce that the  Major Update of BluBoy is now Live!

[b]Updates:[/b]

-Map system
-Hint system
-Unique guards Model
-Changes in Special Ability
-Invisible wall
-Minor Changes that make the game better
-other bug fixes
-Old Save Data won't work

[b]Map System:[/b]

Now there is no need to get lost in the game since you got the Map System.

[b]Hint System:[/b]

Hints available wherever possible that makes the game even better.

[b]Unique Guards Model:[/b]

No more clones now guards have almost unique models.

[b]Invisible Wall:[/b]

The invisible wall now has a separate material so that gamers don't get confused as the bug.

[b]Old Save Data won't work:[/b]

Sorry to say that the old save data won't work due to some major changes in the game.

Special thanks to [i]Rayk Kerstan[/i] for giving me some valuable tips.

Thanks for each and everyone downloaded the game.

Support me by downloading and sharing the Game.

I am really working hard to make the game better.

Meet you guys at the next update.

Happy Gaming!

[i]"your journey is about to begin"[/i]

Hussain.A
